jsonld.name: Charcuterie Bree
jsonld.description: Home-based charcuterie and catering studio in Kendall, Miami, FL. Custom charcuterie boards, charcuterie cups, grazing tables and catering spreads for birthdays, holidays and events.

eyebrow.es: Kendall, Miami, FL · Charcutería y catering

parrafo.es: Charcuterie Bree arma tablas de charcutería, cups individuales, mesas de grazing y boxes personalizados para cumpleaños, días festivos, baby showers y eventos corporativos en Kendall y todo Miami-Dade. Cada montaje se hace a mano, fresco y a tu medida.
parrafo.en: Charcuterie Bree builds charcuterie boards, individual cups, grazing tables and custom boxes for birthdays, holidays, baby showers and corporate events around Kendall and Miami-Dade. Every spread is arranged by hand, fresh, and built around your occasion.

hero.imagen_alt: Classic charcuterie board with cheese, crackers, fruit and nuts by Charcuterie Bree

parrafo_1.es: Charcuterie Bree es un estudio de charcutería casero en Kendall, Miami, construido alrededor de una idea simple: cada tabla debe verse tan bien como sabe. Desde un cup individual hasta una mesa de grazing completa, cada pedido se arma a mano para la ocasión.
parrafo_1.en: Charcuterie Bree is a home-based charcuterie studio in Kendall, Miami built around one simple idea: every board should look as good as it tastes. From a single cup to a full grazing table, each order is arranged by hand for the occasion.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes vuelven para cumpleaños, días festivos, baby showers y eventos corporativos, y piden tablas temáticas para cada ocasión, desde cups individuales para grupos grandes hasta montajes especiales de temporada.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep coming back for birthdays, holidays, baby showers and corporate events, and ask for themed boards built around the occasion, from individual cups for a big group to special seasonal spreads.

items.quote: Bree and her charcuterie boards are the absolute best! She decorates all her boards beautifully and uses great quality cheeses and meats for a great price. She is creative and has plenty of options to choose from savory or sweet! 10/10 !!

I've purchased boards from Charcuterie Bree on several occasions, and she never disappoints! Boards are alway a visual delight and delicious! Bree is so accommodating and friendly, and can create something special for any occasion. I'd give her ten stars if I could.

Bree has a great eye for making a beautiful looking board for any occasion from Holidays to special events. She can also custom make any order to fit your needs. We have had the greatest success and compliments whenever we use her.
